meta.name: cyberedge-discover-assets
meta.description: Create an authorized CyberEdge scope, run passive asset discovery, follow task events, and retrieve evidence-backed results through the CyberEdge Agent Protocol. Use when an AI agent must inventory domains or IP space that has an explicit authorization reference; never use for active probing or targets outside that scope.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对授权范围内的域名和IP进行被动资产发现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化发现授权范围内的网络资产
copy.tagline_en: Discover authorized domains and IPs through passive asset discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate discovery of authorized network assets

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的授权引用，自动创建扫描范围，执行被动资产发现（如DNS和证书透明度），跟踪扫描进度，并返回带证据的资产清单。
howto.when: 当你提供明确的授权引用和具体目标（如域名或IP段），并指示 Claude 盘点资产时触发。

say.text: 用授权REF-001扫描example.com的被动资产。
say.note: Claude会创建范围、启动被动扫描，最后返回资产列表。

say.text: 查看之前对example.com的资产变化。
say.note: Claude会检索自上次扫描以来的新增或消失资产。

say.text: 对IP段10.0.0.0/24做被动DNS发现，授权码AUTH001。
say.note: 仅执行DNS解析的被动扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create an authorized scope, run passive asset discovery (DNS + Certificate Transparency), track scan progress, and return evidence-backed asset lists based on your authorization reference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a clear authorization reference and specific targets (e.g., domain or IP range) and ask Claude to inventory assets.

say_en.text: Discover passive assets for example.com with authorization REF-001.
say_en.note: Claude creates scope, starts passive scan, and returns asset list.

say_en.text: Check asset changes for example.com since last scan.
say_en.note: Claude retrieves appeared or disappeared assets from evidence.

say_en.text: Run passive DNS discovery on 10.0.0.0/24 with auth AUTH001.
say_en.note: Performs DNS-only passive scan with the given policy.
